subject: Television & Streaming
title: Ad-Supported Free Streaming
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Ad-Supported Free Streaming.

hook.text: Tubi, Pluto TV, and Freevee offer thousands of movies and shows for free. The catch: lots of ads.

buildup.text: These FAST channels (Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV) quietly built massive audiences with zero subscription fees.

discovery.text: Tubi reached 74 million monthly users by 2023. Most viewers didn't even know it existed five years earlier.

twist.text: Free streaming appeals to viewers exhausted by subscription costs.

climax.text: The streaming industry may end up where broadcast began: mostly free, mostly ad-supported, with a premium tier on top.

punchline.text: Free TV never died. It just changed addresses.

quiz.question: What does FAST stand for in streaming?
